listening.imageAlt: Một tấm biển gỗ ghi 'Cycle Parking' đặt bên lối đi cát cạnh bụi cây

audio.text: A bicycle is being unlocked.
Some shrubs are being trimmed.
A path is blocked by a fence.
A sign has been posted beside a path.

options: A path is blocked by a fence.
A sign has been posted beside a path.

why.vi: Biển báo được đặt cạnh lối đi: has been posted. Không có ai mở khóa hay cắt tỉa.
why.en: A sign stands beside the path, so (D) fits. Nobody is unlocking or trimming.

questions.trap: Câu (B) dễ nhầm vì có bụi cây phía sau biển, nhưng không ai đang cắt tỉa.

audio.text: When does the exhibit open to the public?
Yes, it was open.
To the public library.
Not until the fire inspection is done.

options: Not until the fire inspection is done.

why.vi: When có thể trả lời bằng điều kiện: 'Not until the inspection is done'.
why.en: 'When' can be answered by a condition, as 'Not until the inspection is done' does.

questions.trap: (B) lặp public nhưng là địa điểm.

audio.text: Why wasn't the invoice paid on time?
Accounting never forwarded it to me.
It's due at the end of March.
I paid by credit card.

options: Accounting never forwarded it to me.
It's due at the end of March.

why.vi: Why hỏi lý do; 'Accounting never forwarded it' giải thích vì sao chưa trả.
why.en: 'Why' asks for a reason, and the accounting department not forwarding it explains why.

questions.trap: (B) trả lời When và (C) nói cách trả tiền; cả hai đều lặp chủ đề nhưng không giải thích.

audio.text: How do you like your new apartment?
The commute is much shorter.
Two bedrooms and a balcony.
Yes, I do.

why.vi: 'How do you like' hỏi cảm nhận; 'The commute is much shorter' nêu điều thích.
why.en: 'How do you like' asks for an opinion, and the shorter commute is the speaker's reaction.

questions.trap: (B) chỉ mô tả căn hộ (What), không nói cảm nhận.

audio.text: Why don't we ask the supplier for a discount?
He's a discount shopper.
They already offered ten percent.
The supplier is from Taiwan.

why.vi: Đây là lời gợi ý; 'They already offered ten percent' báo rằng việc đó đã xảy ra, phản hồi hợp lý.
why.en: This is a suggestion, and 'They already offered ten percent' replies by saying it has already happened.

questions.trap: (A) và (C) lặp discount và supplier nhưng không phản hồi gợi ý.

audio.text: Did you finish the sales report?
It was a nice sale.
Almost, I just need the charts.
Yes, the finish is smooth.

options: Almost, I just need the charts.

why.vi: Câu hỏi Yes/No; 'Almost' trả lời gián tiếp rằng chưa xong hẳn.
why.en: In a yes/no question, 'Almost' is a direct partial answer.

questions.trap: (A) và (C) lặp sale và finish với nghĩa khác.

audio.text: Is the café open on Mondays?
No, it's closed for cleaning that day.
Monday is my day off.
Open the door, please.

options: No, it's closed for cleaning that day.

why.vi: Yes/No: 'No' kèm lý do là câu trả lời trực tiếp.
why.en: 'No' with a reason answers the question directly.

questions.trap: (B) lặp Monday nhưng nói về mình, không nói về quán.

audio.text: Do you know where the meeting is?
At nine thirty.
Yes, in room 204.
No, I met him last week.

options: No, I met him last week.

why.vi: 'Do you know where' là Yes/No kết hợp Where; 'Yes, in room 204' trả lời cả hai.
why.en: 'Yes, in room 204' answers both the yes/no and the where.

questions.trap: (A) chỉ trả lời When.

audio.text: Good morning, Pacific Bistro. How can I help you?
Hi, I'm calling about a booking for Saturday evening. We're a group of twelve, and I'd like to make sure you can seat us together.
Let me check. We do have a private room at the back, but it's usually reserved for parties of fifteen or more.
Oh, I see. Is there any chance of an exception? It's a retirement dinner for a colleague.
Congratulations to him! I'll ask the manager and call you back within the hour.
That would be great. My number's on the reservation.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
options: To arrange seating for a group

why.vi: Anh ấy gọi để đặt chỗ ngồi chung cho nhóm 12 người.
why.en: He wants a table for a group of twelve.

questions.trap: Anh ấy không phàn nàn gì; chỉ hỏi về chỗ ngồi.

questions.q: What is the occasion?

why.vi: Anh nói đây là bữa tối chia tay nghỉ hưu của một đồng nghiệp.
why.en: He says it is a dinner for a colleague who is retiring.

questions.trap: Birthday hay gặp trong bài nhưng ở đây không được nhắc.

questions.q: What will the woman do?

why.vi: Cô sẽ hỏi quản lý và gọi lại, tức là tham khảo ý kiến quản lý.
why.en: She will ask the manager, which means consult a manager.

questions.trap: Cô chưa hủy gì cả.

audio.text: Maria, the assembly line stopped again around ten o'clock. It's the third time this week.
I know. The maintenance team says a sensor on the conveyor belt keeps failing.
Can't they just replace it?
They already did once, but the new one is the same model. They're going to order a different type from another supplier.
How long will that take?
About four days. In the meantime, we'll run the line at half speed.
All right. I'll tell the night shift so they aren't surprised.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?

why.vi: Cảm biến trên băng chuyền hỏng liên tục, tức là thiết bị lỗi.
why.en: A sensor on the conveyor keeps failing, which is faulty equipment.

questions.trap: Late shipment không được đề cập; chỉ có thiết bị hỏng.

questions.q: What will the maintenance team do?

why.vi: Họ sẽ đặt loại cảm biến khác từ nhà cung cấp khác.
why.en: They will order another type of sensor, so a different part.

questions.trap: Replace the old one họ đã làm rồi, lần này là đặt loại khác.

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?

why.vi: Anh sẽ báo cho ca đêm để họ không bất ngờ.
why.en: He will tell the night shift, meaning inform them.

questions.trap: Anh không gọi nhà cung cấp; đó là việc của đội bảo trì.

audio.text: Hello, Mr. Torres. Thanks for coming in for the interview.
Thank you for having me. I've been following your company's growth for a while.
Your résumé says you've managed a sales team of eight. Could you tell me about that?
Sure. Over two years we increased regional sales by about twenty percent, mostly through better training.
That's impressive. This position involves a lot of travel. Is that something you're comfortable with?
Oh, absolutely. In my current role I'm on the road about half the month.

questions.q: What is the conversation mainly about?

why.vi: Cô ấy cảm ơn anh đến phỏng vấn và hỏi về kinh nghiệm, nên đây là buổi phỏng vấn.
why.en: The woman thanks him for coming in for the interview.

questions.trap: Có nói về travel và sales nhưng chỉ là chi tiết của buổi phỏng vấn.

questions.q: How did the man improve sales?

why.vi: Anh nói doanh số tăng chủ yếu nhờ đào tạo tốt hơn.
why.en: He credits better training for the increase.

questions.trap: Lowering prices không được nhắc tới.

questions.q: What does the woman ask about?

why.vi: Cô hỏi anh có thoải mái với việc đi công tác nhiều không.
why.en: She asks if he is comfortable with frequent travel.

questions.trap: Salary là thứ thường được hỏi nhưng ở đây chưa nói tới.

audio.text: Hi, this is Dan from Building Services. I'm calling about the air conditioning on your floor.
Oh, good. It's been so warm in the east wing that people are working in the lobby.
Sorry about that. The unit needs a new part, and it won't arrive until Thursday.
Thursday? We have clients visiting on Wednesday afternoon.
In that case, I can bring in two portable cooling units tomorrow morning as a temporary fix.
That would really help. Could you set them up in the main conference room?
No problem. I'll be there by eight.

questions.q: What is the problem?
options: An elevator is out of service
A cooling system is not working properly

why.vi: Điều hòa ở cánh đông quá nóng, tức là hệ thống làm mát không hoạt động tốt.
why.en: The east wing is too warm because the air conditioning is faulty.

questions.trap: Lobby chỉ là nơi mọi người tạm làm việc.

questions.q: Why is the woman concerned about Wednesday?

why.vi: Khách hàng sẽ đến thăm vào chiều thứ Tư.
why.en: Clients will visit that afternoon, so visitors are coming.

questions.trap: Không có hạn chót nào được nhắc.

questions.q: What will the man do tomorrow morning?

why.vi: Anh sẽ mang hai máy làm mát di động đến làm giải pháp tạm.
why.en: He will set up two portable units as a temporary fix.

questions.trap: Part thay chính thức đến thứ Năm, không phải ngày mai.

audio.text: Hi, I bought this blender last month, but the lid cracked after only a few uses.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt with you?
Yes, it's right here. I know the warranty covers one year.
That's right. We can either send it to the manufacturer for repair, or I can exchange it for a new one today.
An exchange sounds better. I use it every morning at my café.
Then let me check that we have the same model in stock. Just one moment.

questions.q: Why is the woman at the store?
options: To get a defective item replaced

why.vi: Nắp máy xay bị nứt, cô muốn được đổi hàng lỗi.
why.en: Her blender lid cracked and she wants a replacement.

questions.trap: Mua máy mới không đúng vì cô đã có máy từ tháng trước.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the warranty?

why.vi: Bảo hành một năm, tức là mười hai tháng.
why.en: One year equals twelve months.

questions.trap: Cô mua tháng trước, nên chưa hết hạn.

questions.q: What will the man do next?

why.vi: Anh sẽ kiểm tra xem còn cùng mẫu trong kho không.
why.en: He will check if the same model is in stock, i.e. check inventory.

questions.trap: Gửi về nhà sản xuất là phương án cô đã từ chối.

audio.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we start the shift on Line Three, I would like to talk about a change in our safety procedure. Starting today, every worker must wear safety glasses as well as gloves when using the cutting machine. Last month, two small accidents happened because workers removed their glasses to clean them. Please keep a spare pair in your locker. New glasses are available free from the supply room, which opens at seven fifteen. Supervisors will check the equipment at the start of each shift. If you notice a damaged machine, stop work and tell your supervisor immediately.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the talk?

why.vi: Người nói thông báo quy định mới: phải đeo kính bảo hộ cùng găng tay.
why.en: The speaker explains a new safety rule.

questions.trap: New machine sai vì máy cắt đã có sẵn từ trước.

questions.q: Why did two accidents happen last month?

why.vi: Công nhân tháo kính ra để lau nên xảy ra hai tai nạn nhỏ.
why.en: Workers removed their glasses to clean them.

questions.trap: Machine damaged sai vì đó là điều phải báo cáo nếu phát hiện, không phải nguyên nhân tai nạn.

questions.q: Where can workers get new glasses?

why.vi: Kính mới được phát miễn phí ở phòng vật tư.
why.en: New glasses are available from the supply room.

questions.trap: Lockers là nơi cất kính dự phòng của mình.

audio.text: Hello, and welcome to the Dalton Furniture factory. I am Greg, and I will be showing you around today. On this tour, you will see how a chair travels from raw wood to finished product. First we will visit the cutting area, then the assembly line, and finally the quality control room, where every item is inspected before it leaves the plant. Please note that photographs are allowed only in the showroom. Also, it can get loud on the factory floor, so I will give each of you a pair of earplugs. We will end the tour in the showroom, where you can buy items at a discount.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?

why.vi: Greg nói anh sẽ dẫn khách đi tham quan nhà máy.
why.en: He says he will show visitors around the factory.

questions.trap: Quality inspector sai vì phòng kiểm tra chỉ là một điểm dừng.

questions.q: Where may visitors take photographs?

why.vi: Chỉ được chụp ảnh trong phòng trưng bày.
why.en: Photographs are allowed only in the showroom.

questions.trap: Các khu vực còn lại là nơi tham quan nhưng cấm chụp.

questions.q: What can visitors do at the end of the tour?

why.vi: Cuối buổi tham quan, khách có thể mua hàng giảm giá ở phòng trưng bày.
why.en: They can buy items at a discount in the showroom.

questions.trap: Free chair sai vì chỉ có giảm giá, không phải tặng.

questions.q: The meeting begins ____ 9:30 A.M.

why.vi: Giờ cụ thể dùng "at".
why.en: "At" with a clock time.

questions.trap: "On" dùng cho ngày.

questions.q: The seminar is held ____ Tuesdays.

why.vi: Thứ trong tuần dùng "on".
why.en: "On" with days.

questions.trap: "In Tuesdays" sai.

questions.q: The festival takes place ____ July.

why.vi: Tháng dùng "in".
why.en: "In" with months.

questions.trap: "On July" chỉ dùng với ngày cụ thể.

questions.q: Please submit the form ____ Friday.

why.vi: "By" là hạn chót.
why.en: "By" marks a deadline.

questions.trap: "During" cần khoảng thời gian.

questions.q: The store will be closed ____ the renovation.

why.vi: Sau chỗ trống là danh từ nên cần giới từ "during".
why.en: A noun follows, so the preposition "during".

questions.trap: "While" cần mệnh đề.

questions.q: We have worked here ____ 2019.

why.vi: "Since" + mốc thời gian.
why.en: "Since" + starting point.

questions.trap: "For 2019" sai vì "for" cần khoảng thời gian.

questions.q: The conference lasts ____ three days.

why.vi: "For" + khoảng thời gian.
why.en: "For" + duration.

questions.trap: "Since three days" sai.

questions.q: The café is located ____ the second floor.

why.vi: Tầng dùng "on".
why.en: "On" with floors.

questions.trap: "In the second floor" sai.

questions.q: The parking lot is ____ the library and the bank.

why.vi: Giữa hai vật dùng "between".
why.en: "Between" for two items.

questions.trap: "Among" dùng cho ba vật trở lên.

questions.q: The tour group walked ____ the tunnel to the shark tank.

why.vi: Đi xuyên qua đường hầm: through.
why.en: Walking through a tunnel.

questions.trap: "Over" nghĩa là đi trên đầu.

passages.title: New factory for Greenfield Plastics
passages.text: Greenfield Plastics, a maker of kitchen containers, will open a second factory [1] the town of Millbrook next spring. The new building stands [2] the river, about ten minutes from the highway. The site covers about four hectares and has room for a large parking area. Construction began last year, and the company will start production [3] April 2. [4] Mayor Ellen Park said the project is good news for the town. She added that she hopes other manufacturers will follow, because the area has plenty of space and a skilled workforce. Greenfield Plastics now has one factory, in the city of Ridgeway, where about 300 people work. Visitors will be welcome at the new plant on the first Saturday of each month.

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: Dùng "in" trước tên thị trấn (địa điểm lớn): "in the town of Millbrook".
why.en: We use "in" before the name of a town: "in the town of Millbrook".

questions.trap: "at" dùng cho điểm cụ thể nhỏ hơn như địa chỉ hoặc trạm.

questions.q: Blank [2]

why.vi: "beside the river" nghĩa là ngay cạnh con sông. "Besides" nghĩa là ngoài ra.
why.en: "beside the river" means next to the river. "Besides" means "in addition to".

questions.trap: "besides" chỉ khác "beside" một chữ s nhưng nghĩa hoàn toàn khác.

questions.q: Blank [3]

why.vi: Dùng "on" với ngày cụ thể: "on April 2".
why.en: We use "on" with a specific date: "on April 2".

questions.trap: "in April" đúng khi chỉ có tháng, nhưng có ngày thì phải là "on".

questions.q: Blank [4]
options: Plastic containers are sold in many kinds of stores.
The factory will employ about 120 local workers.
Many visitors walk along the river in summer.
The company was started by a teacher in 1980.

why.vi: Câu sau nói "Mayor said the project is good news", nên câu chèn phải nói điều tốt cho thị trấn: tạo khoảng 120 việc làm.
why.en: The next sentence says the mayor called the project good news, so the missing sentence must give the benefit: 120 local jobs.

questions.trap: Các câu về cửa hàng, khách tham quan, người sáng lập không giải thích vì sao đó là tin tốt.

title.vi: At / on / in và by / until / for

rule.vi: AT + giờ, điểm. ON + thứ, ngày, mặt phẳng. IN + tháng, năm, không gian. BY = trước hoặc đúng hạn. UNTIL = kéo dài đến. FOR + khoảng thời gian. SINCE + mốc.
rule.en: AT + clock time, point. ON + day, date, surface. IN + month, year, enclosed space. BY = no later than. UNTIL = continues up to. FOR + duration. SINCE + starting point.

theory.formula: at 9:30 | on Tuesday | in July | by Friday | until May 1 | for 3 days | since 2019

examples.en: Please submit the form by Friday.

theory.tip: Mẹo thi: hỏi "việc này làm một lần trước hạn" thì chọn by; "việc này kéo dài đến lúc đó" thì chọn until. Nhớ by = bơi tới bờ, until = bơi mãi tới bờ.

passages.title: Harlow Woodworks to Open Second Plant
passages.text:
BRISTOL (June 3) - Harlow Woodworks, a maker of office furniture, announced on Monday that it will open a second manufacturing plant in nearby Keswick this autumn. The new facility, which will occupy a former textile mill, is expected to raise the company's output by 40 percent.

"Our current plant has been running at full capacity for two years," said CEO Marta Lindqvist. "Customers have waited as long as eight weeks for desks and storage units. We want to bring that down to three."

The company plans to hire 60 workers, most of them for assembly and quality control. Training will begin in August, before the building is complete, at the existing plant. Ms. Lindqvist added that the new plant will use timber from certified forests only, a policy that Harlow has followed since 2019. Production at the Keswick site is scheduled to start on October 1.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: The closing of a textile mill
A company's plan to expand production
The launch of a new furniture line

why.vi: Cả bài nói về nhà máy thứ hai và việc tăng sản lượng 40%.
why.en: The article reports a second plant and a 40 percent rise in output.

questions.trap: Textile mill chỉ là tòa nhà cũ được tận dụng, không phải chủ đề.

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Lindqvist mention?

why.vi: "Customers have waited as long as eight weeks."
why.en: She says customers have waited up to eight weeks for orders.

questions.trap: Gỗ được nhắc đến nhưng chỉ về chứng nhận rừng, không nói thiếu gỗ.

questions.q: What is NOT true about the Keswick plant?
options: It will employ about 60 new workers.
It will be located in a former mill.
It will begin producing furniture in August.

why.vi: Tháng 8 chỉ là lúc bắt đầu đào tạo; sản xuất bắt đầu ngày 1 tháng 10.
why.en: August is when training begins; production starts on October 1.

questions.trap: Dễ nhầm "August" vì nó xuất hiện trong bài, nhưng nó gắn với đào tạo chứ không phải sản xuất.

questions.q: The word "certified" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

why.vi: "Certified forests" là rừng được cơ quan có thẩm quyền công nhận.
why.en: "Certified" here means officially approved or recognized.

passages.title: Evening Tours Coming to Blue Harbor
passages.text:
Blue Harbor Aquarium will offer evening tours on the first and third Friday of each month, starting in September, the aquarium's director announced yesterday. The one-hour tours begin at 7:00 P.M. and are limited to 15 guests so that visitors can spend more time with the keepers.

Unlike daytime visits, the evening tour includes a stop at the jellyfish nursery, which is normally closed to the public. Guests will also watch the keepers prepare the night feeding.

"Many families told us the aquarium is too crowded on weekends," said director Ha Tran. "We wanted an option that is calm."

Tickets cost $18 for adults and $10 for children under 12 and must be purchased online at least one day in advance. The aquarium café will stay open until 8:30 P.M. on tour nights.

questions.q: How often will the evening tours be held?
options: On the first and third Friday of each month
Once a month on a Saturday

why.vi: "the first and third Friday of each month".
why.en: The tours are offered "on the first and third Friday of each month."

questions.q: What is different about the evening tour?
options: It includes dinner at the café

why.vi: "Unlike daytime visits, the evening tour includes a stop at the jellyfish nursery."
why.en: Only the evening tour includes the normally closed nursery.

questions.trap: Café mở đến 8:30 nhưng bài không nói bữa tối nằm trong tour.

questions.q: How much would two adults and one 8-year-old child pay for the tour?

why.vi: Hai người lớn $18 x 2 = $36, cộng một trẻ dưới 12 tuổi $10 = $46.
why.en: Two adults at $18 plus one child at $10 equals $46.

questions.trap: Quên cộng vé trẻ em sẽ ra $36.

passages.title: Line upgrade at Nolan Bicycle Works
passages.text: Nolan Bicycle Works announced on Monday that it will replace the assembly line at its Eastfield factory. The new line, which will be installed over the first two weeks of November, is expected to raise output from 400 to 650 frames per day. Plant manager Teresa Boyd said the company chose automated welding machines because they produce more consistent joints than manual welding. "Quality complaints from retailers have dropped each year, and we want that trend to continue," she said. During the installation, production will continue on a smaller line in Building C, so customer orders will not be delayed. Nolan also plans to hire 30 technicians next spring to operate the new equipment. Interested applicants can find details on the company's Web site.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: A factory's plan to replace its assembly line
A recall of defective bicycle frames
The opening of a new retail store
A change in the company's management

why.vi: Câu đầu nêu ngay: sẽ thay dây chuyền lắp ráp ở nhà máy Eastfield. Các chi tiết sau đều xoay quanh việc này.
why.en: The first sentence says the company will replace the assembly line at its factory.

questions.trap: Chữ "quality complaints" dễ làm nghĩ đến chuyện thu hồi hàng, nhưng bài chỉ nói khiếu nại đang giảm.

questions.q: According to Ms. Boyd, why did the company choose automated welding machines?
options: They can be installed in one day.

why.vi: Bà Boyd nói máy hàn tự động "produce more consistent joints". Bài không nói về chi phí hay số nhân viên cần ít hơn.
why.en: She says the machines "produce more consistent joints than manual welding."

questions.trap: Bài còn nói sẽ tuyển 30 kỹ thuật viên, nên "fewer technicians" là sai.

questions.q: The word "output" in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to

why.vi: "Raise output from 400 to 650 frames per day" tức là tăng sản lượng, đồng nghĩa với production.
why.en: Raising output from 400 to 650 frames a day means raising production.

questions.trap: "Inventory" là hàng tồn kho, không phải số lượng làm ra mỗi ngày.

passages.title: New protective equipment
passages.text:
MEMO
To: Packaging Department
From: Hector Alvarez, Safety Supervisor
Date: March 3
Subject: New protective equipment

Beginning Monday, March 10, all employees who enter the packaging area must wear safety glasses and ear protection. The new equipment has arrived and may be collected from the supply room between 7:00 A.M. and 3:00 P.M. Please bring your employee badge. Anyone without the proper equipment on Monday will be asked to leave the area until it is collected. Supervisors will check compliance each morning. Questions about sizes or fittings should be directed to the safety office.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a new safety requirement

why.vi: Memo mở đầu bằng quy định mới: từ thứ Hai phải đeo kính và nút chống ồn. Đó là một yêu cầu an toàn mới.
why.en: The memo announces that protective gear will be required from March 10.

questions.trap: Chữ "supervisor" chỉ là người gửi và người kiểm tra, không phải nội dung chính.

questions.q: What should employees bring to the supply room?

why.vi: "Please bring your employee badge" nói ngay sau chỗ nhận đồ ở supply room.
why.en: The memo says, "Please bring your employee badge."

questions.trap: "Safety office" chỉ là nơi hỏi về size, không phải nơi nhận đồ.

audio.text: Have you booked the hotel yet?
The hotel has a pool.
Yes, he's booked.
Not yet, I'm comparing prices.

why.vi: 'Not yet' trả lời Yes/No đúng với thì hiện tại hoàn thành.
why.en: 'Not yet' is the natural negative answer to a 'yet' question.

questions.trap: (A) lặp hotel nhưng không trả lời đã đặt chưa.

audio.text: Are you coming to the staff lunch?
I have a client call, unfortunately.
Lunch is at noon.
Yes, the staff is friendly.

options: I have a client call, unfortunately.

why.vi: Từ chối gián tiếp: có cuộc gọi khách hàng nên không đến.
why.en: This is an indirect 'no': a client call prevents attendance.

questions.trap: (B) lặp lunch và nói giờ, không nói bạn có đến hay không.

audio.text: Can I borrow your stapler?
Sure, it's on my desk.
I stapled the pages.
Yes, the borrower is here.

why.vi: Đây là lời xin mượn; 'Sure, it's on my desk' đồng ý.
why.en: This is a request to borrow, and 'Sure, it's on my desk' agrees.

questions.trap: (B) lặp stapler dưới dạng động từ nhưng nói về việc đã làm.

questions.q: Your order will arrive ____ five business days.

why.vi: "Within" nghĩa là trong vòng.
why.en: "Within" means inside that period.

questions.trap: "During" không đi với số ngày.

questions.q: The new sign was hung ____ the entrance.

why.vi: Treo phía trên: above.
why.en: Hung higher up: above.

questions.trap: "Among" cần nhiều vật.

questions.q: The group of tourists ____ outside the gate.

why.vi: Chủ ngữ "group" số ít.
why.en: The head noun "group" is singular.

questions.trap: "Tourists" gần động từ làm rối.

questions.q: The director ____ approval we need is traveling.

why.vi: "Whose approval" chỉ sở hữu.
why.en: "Whose approval" shows possession.

questions.trap: "Whom approval" sai.

questions.q: The company announced the ____ of a new branch.

why.vi: Sau "the" cần danh từ.
why.en: A noun after "the".

questions.trap: "Openly" là trạng từ nghĩa khác.

questions.q: The results were ____ better than expected.

why.vi: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho "better".
why.en: Adverb modifying the comparative "better".

questions.trap: "Considerable" tính từ không bổ nghĩa cho tính từ.

questions.q: ____ of the rooms has a view of the lake.

why.vi: "None of the rooms" + số ít.
why.en: "None of the rooms" + singular verb.

questions.trap: "No of" sai.

questions.q: Please be careful ____ the glass.

why.vi: Cụm cố định: careful with.
why.en: Fixed phrase: careful with.

questions.trap: "Careful to" nghĩa khác.

questions.q: The letters ____ by the assistant.

why.vi: Thư được đánh máy nên bị động.
why.en: Letters were typed: passive.

questions.trap: "Typed" một mình thiếu động từ.

questions.q: She has worked here ____ ten years.

why.vi: "For" + khoảng thời gian.
why.en: "For" + a length of time.

questions.trap: "Since ten years" là lỗi quen thuộc.
